listeners.name: onInitializing
listeners.description: SDK initialization has started.

listeners.name: onInitialized
listeners.description: SDK initialization completed successfully.

listeners.name: onInitFailed
listeners.description: SDK initialization failed.

listeners.name: onLoginSucceeded
listeners.description: SDK login completed successfully.

listeners.name: onLoginFailed
listeners.description: SDK login failed.

listeners.name: onLoggedOut
listeners.description: The current SDK session logged out.

listeners.name: onDisposed
listeners.description: The SDK client has been disposed.

listeners.name: onConnectionStatusChanged
listeners.description: The connection status changed (connection://status). Replace the held status whole and hand it to the Kit ConnectionNotice unchanged.

listeners.name: onAccessSwitched
listeners.description: The IM connection moved to another access point (access://switched).

listeners.name: onAccessChanged
listeners.description: A new access manifest was accepted (access://changed).

listeners.name: onUpdateState
listeners.description: The update center state changed (update://state). Delivered with a session; before sign-in read update.getState.

listeners.name: onMessageReceived
listeners.description: A single message was received.

listeners.name: onMessageReceivedBatch
listeners.description: A batch of messages was received.

listeners.name: onMessageSendAck
listeners.description: A message send operation was acknowledged.

listeners.name: onMessageSendFailed
listeners.description: A message send operation failed.

listeners.name: onMessageRecalled
listeners.description: A message was recalled.

listeners.name: onMessageEdited
listeners.description: A message was edited.

listeners.name: onMessageDeleted
listeners.description: A message was deleted.

listeners.name: onMessageReadReceipt
listeners.description: A message read receipt changed.

listeners.name: onMessageReactionChanged
listeners.description: A message reaction changed.

listeners.name: onInputStatusChanged
listeners.description: A conversation input or typing status changed.

listeners.name: onTypingAggregateChanged
listeners.description: Aggregated typing status changed for a large conversation.

listeners.name: onMessageBurned
listeners.description: A burn-after-read message was burned.

listeners.name: onMessagePinned
listeners.description: A message was pinned.

listeners.name: onMessageUnpinned
listeners.description: A message was unpinned.

listeners.name: onMessagePluginStateChanged
listeners.description: Plugin card state on a local message changed: the shared layer Core publishes for the card's entity (events, sync, the caller's own result) or the viewer's local layer. Re-present that message with its messageId; version is the local layer's when that changed, the shared layer's otherwise.

listeners.name: onViewUpdated
listeners.description: A core observable view changed: the next revision, as a delta or a snapshot.

listeners.name: onNewConversation
listeners.description: A new conversation was created or discovered.

listeners.name: onConversationChanged
listeners.description: Important conversation fields changed.

listeners.name: onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged
listeners.description: The total unread message count changed.

listeners.name: onConversationDeleted
listeners.description: A conversation was deleted.

listeners.name: onSyncServerStart
listeners.description: Server conversation or message sync started.

listeners.name: onSyncServerFinish
listeners.description: Server conversation or message sync finished.

listeners.name: onSyncServerFailed
listeners.description: Server conversation or message sync failed.

listeners.name: onSyncProgress
listeners.description: Server sync progress changed.

listeners.name: onUploadProgress
listeners.description: Media upload progress changed.

listeners.name: onDownloadProgress
listeners.description: Media download progress changed.

listeners.name: onPluginRealtime
listeners.description: A plugin delivered a realtime packet to this user's online connections (im.realtime.deliver): online only, at most once, never stored. Expired packets and payloads that are not JSON objects never arrive. Route by pluginId and packetType.

listeners.name: onPluginCatalogChanged
listeners.description: The tenant's plugin catalog changed (a plugin enabled, disabled or reconfigured). The SDK has already invalidated its plugin catalog; read plugin entries and configuration again. Arrives a random 0-3 s after the notice, with the notices of 3 s merged into one.

listeners.name: onNotificationPresent
listeners.description: Show a notification, or replace the one with the same collapseId: an in-app banner (surface inApp) while the app is in the foreground, a system notification (surface system) while it is in the background and the platform presents alerts itself. Title and body are rendered in the app's language; sound says whether to play one.

listeners.name: onNotificationClear
listeners.description: Remove the notifications with these collapse ids (their conversations were read or deleted), or every notification of the app when all is true (the session ended).

listeners.name: onNotificationBadge
listeners.description: Set the app badge to count, the unread total as the conversation list counts it. Reported when the total changes, after login and when the app returns to the foreground.
